assertions.name: brioschi_closed_form_matches_companion_discriminant
assertions.source: Brioschi discriminant Δ(x^5 + bx + c) = 256·b^5 + 3125·c^4 matches the companion-matrix product Δ = a^{2n-2}·Π_{i<j}(r_i − r_j)^2 to 50 dps.

assertions.name: delta_at_alpha_0_equals_800000
assertions.source: Bring form y^5 + 5y + α at α=0 has discriminant Δ = 256·5^5 = 800000, confirming the base point of the Bring family is non-degenerate.

description: GAP-A-4 T12 — Bring quintic discriminant scaffold.  Verifies the Brioschi closed-form 256·b^5 + 3125·c^4 against the numerical companion-matrix discriminant, documents the Bring form's discriminant structure (Δ = 800000 + 3125·α^4), and closes the T9 follow-up triple by pinning the classical scaffold.  No h-deformation derivation proposed.

q-analogue of the Hermite icosahedral resolvent

data.synthesis_verdict: T12 closes the T9 follow-up triple (T10 McKay-character, T11 Klein J-invariant, T12 Bring discriminant) by pinning the classical Bring quintic scaffold: (a) Brioschi-form discriminant Δ(x^5 + bx + c) = 256·b^5 + 3125·c^4 verified via companion-matrix numerical agreement at (b,c) = (2,3); (b) Bring-form Δ = 800000 + 3125·α^4 with degenerate locus α^4 + 256 = 0 (4 ramification points on the icosahedral covering). The h-deformation question stays OPEN as a scaffold per formalize-first discipline — pursuing it requires both the q-Klein invariants from T11's open follow-up AND a q-analogue of the Hermite icosahedral resolvent, each a substantial standalone project.
